Thanks for the ping — I pulled the CSV and did an initial correlation of request headers and session fingerprints. Observations:

- The CSV shows 9 credit/top-up requests tied to two billing emails (billing@venturi.ai and bn-support@venturi.ai) over the last 21 days.
- Several session IDs reuse the same IP ranges and have identical user-agent strings (likely scripted).
- Two distinct projects (VL-31, VL-32) appear under the same billing org but created via different signup emails.

Recommendation: do not auto-approve additional credits yet. Ask Venturi for proof of distinct teams (org chart or procurement ticket number) and provide a temporary sandbox credit with limited token allowance while procurement finishes. I've attached a screenshot of the session list for reference.

If they provide a procurement ticket or PO number and confirm consolidated billing, we can approve an extended trial.

Ben Carter
Fraud & Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

Elise —

Thanks for the quick replies and the procurement ticket link (I pulled it: PO# VENT-2027-055). Ben's team flagged a couple of unusual indicators in the request pattern; to keep your PoC running while we validate, we can do the following right now:

1) Provision a one-time sandbox credit of 150k tokens (valid 72 hours).
2) Rate-limit to 10 requests/min and block suspicious session fingerprints pending your confirmation.
3) Once we receive the PO (VENT-2027-055) and a short note listing the three teams and the primary billing contact, we'll extend a bigger trial for 14 days.

Please reply to confirm and include the procurement contact. If you want me to route the PO to contracts for an expedited invoice, I can do that as well.

Appreciate your patience — want to make sure the teams keep momentum without exposing either side to abuse.
